products.name: Parts Appointment Readiness
products.product: A focused appliance repair parts appointment readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent appliance repair companies and small authorized-service teams
products.problem: A return visit is scheduled from an expected delivery while the correct part, model match, received condition, technician requirements, customer access, and remaining authorization are not verified.
products.valueProposition: Turns appliance repair parts appointment readiness into a visible operating queue so every parts-dependent appointment is released only after the exact usable parts, job scope, technician capability, and customer access are confirmed.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets appliance repair parts tracking, appliance return visit scheduling, repair appointment readiness, and appliance part status searches.

products.name: Warranty Evidence Desk
products.product: A focused appliance repair warranty claim evidence tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent appliance repair companies and small authorized-service teams
products.problem: Manufacturer claim number, authorization, diagnostic codes, model and serial, parts, labor allowances, photos, signatures, invoice, and reimbursement status are re-entered across portals.
products.valueProposition: Turns appliance repair warranty claim evidence tracking into a visible operating queue so every warranty job reaches submission with complete authorized evidence and remains visible until reimbursement, correction, or documented denial.
products.topic: appliance repair warranty claim evidence tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets appliance warranty claim software, warranty service documentation, appliance repair reimbursement, and manufacturer warranty workflow searches.
